notes.title: Just In Time For Halloween, Spooky Mystery Whodunit Is Now Live!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6138946/bfafed816a6a7903571576b1dcf456bb986b04af.png[/img]

[b]Put your detective hat on and solve the untimely murder of a famous video game designer.[/b]

A fabulously wealthy game designer is found dead outside his castle in rural Vermont, and soon evidence shows that this was not merely a freak accident attributed to local superstition. Now it's up to you to investigate the murder and apprehend the guilty. Play as unlikely partners -- ace sleuth Detective Guy and Cleo, the clue-sniffing dog to explore the castle grounds, search for clues, and question suspects. Can you solve the case?
[list]
[*] Murder mystery whodunit
[*] Play as a detective and dog crime-solving team
[*] Explore the area and look for clues
[*] Interview suspects and make deductions
[*] Solve the case and apprehend the guilty
[/list]
“I’m excited to share “Murder Is Game Over” with gamers and mystery fans everywhere. I hope players enjoy the exploration mechanics, spooky atmosphere, and classically-inspired whodunit story,” said Matthew of HitherYon Games. 

[b]Murder Is Game Over[/b] is 20% off until November 1.

notes.title: Patch 0.8 - Pale Islands is available now!
notes.content:
[h2]New locations[/h2]
The world is now split into several locations between which you can travel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39178976/cc3ab1bb69f488a6c52567f58f652648ae262a8a.png[/img]

Location is essentially a packed archipelago, each with its own theme, filled with many encounters, ships and points of interest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39178976/8000456169025c0693ad01f51216876d2c9c571b.png[/img]

As you travel between locations or interact with points of interest you may encounter various events. Ranging from minor issues like rats or disease to a week-long calm, where you struggle to make sure the crew won't go mad, kill each other and overthrow you from Captain position.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39178976/8461645d66cb25a719d5dc8d411fa11a9cb1e497.png[/img]

[h2]Crew rations improvements[/h2]
Following the feedback that we have received in patches 0.6 and 0.7 we came up with a new approach for the food system in Maritime Calling. Every food type is now equal in its effect and the crew eats automatically, allowing you to have a clearer picture of how many days of food you have left.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39178976/2f1621cdda3566c65c60fa2440faacdf47db2f26.png[/img]

You can customize the rations in magnitude ranging from half to double rations, which bears its effect on crew health and morale.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39178976/fe22add7afe1bf6dc0c32fff48ee5eb503841f88.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39178976/ae7a9147d1617459f61e07fb2c573e9889488900.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39178976/cb95372d3e09335f49f47dc62da6ab53ef9aa993.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39178976/3eec99ecaaab209d390156309fcedae48697c922.png[/img]

[h2]Encounters QoL[/h2]
In patch 0.7 we tested a new system for island expeditions, which proved to be a winner out of all other prototypes we had. In this update we have built and expanded upon that system introducing 12 new encounters as well as balancing and improving old ones.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39178976/685a2bcce218f9175ddfc7a1715242baf800d551.png[/img]

The flow of island expeditions is now much smoother. We have added tooltips for keywords and resources, which helps with making better decisions during encounters.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39178976/32ab86e25fa757e21cc6884a1d4d68e79e6f9d7e.png[/img]

notes.title: 0.7 Patch is Completed, Mostly Positive on Steam, Onwards to 2022!
notes.content:
Greetings, seafarers!

I'm happy to say that we finally overcame negative initial reviews and Maritime Calling has reached Mostly Positive Rating! Our struggle was due to having quite an unstable initial release (v.0.6), which was released one week sooner than it should have. We have learned our lesson, and I personally was very happy that 0.7 patch has provided much more coherent and stable launch experience.

We have finished our work on patch 0.7 with the final release standing at 0.7.3. If you haven't checked it out yet - please do and share your gameplay stories with us! 

Now we will finally take a break and recover before we push forward towards the next patch, with a focus to improve gameplay inside the ship.

This year has been very challenging for most of the world and we are no exception. COVID-19 is still a constant threat, influencing many lives and making many things (such as running a fresh indie company) much more difficult. 

However we are all beaten, but not defeated, so from all of us in the Tiamat Games we wish you to have a good 2022!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39178976/5fd5a13c5184dadbfa95a47c1669cf1eb383e353.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch 0.7 is launching tomorrow!
notes.content:
Greetings, seafarers!

We are delighted to announce that patch 0.7 development went along smoothly and we managed to deliver everything that we have planned and even more.

The world feels much more alive, we managed to pull extra performance (20-30 fps), while adding more islands, filled with content (both 2D and 3D).

You will now manage a smaller group of sailors, allowing you to pay much more attention to them and directly assign items to their ship workstations and land expeditions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39178976/e495f466b1937539f40781be3b22dac25bfb1a6d.png[/img]

As of today, December 23rd we are feeling like the game needs an extra day of bug fixing, tuning and polishing, so that we could provide the best quality launch experience for you. 

We hope for your understanding and can't wait for the moment when you'll start sharing your gameplay stories with us!

Here is a sneak peek on a new upcoming feature in 0.7 - ports! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39178976/97548709bb9ca08185dc595f30714dd9750865c2.png[/img]

Port is the main hub of funneling your extra goods, buying rare items and finding rumours leading you to hidden points of interest and treasures.

That's all for today!

notes.title: Patch 0.7 coming live on December 23
notes.content:
Greetings seafarers, today we are happy to announce upcoming patch 0.7!

Our original plan for 0.7 was to just make a small graphics update, but the further we went the more gameplay improvements felt necessary to be included as well. We ended up with a major patch including rework of islands, adding points of interest and equipment system for your crew.

[h2]Visuals update[/h2]
In 0.7 we managed to fix our main bottleneck involving making islands - planting huge forests. Now we are able to make the world much tighter packed and also be more diverse and pleasing to the eye.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39178976/83da7b461f6f0d48060793fa8c69525d87816391.png[/img]

The world in the upcoming patch will contain tens of islands, flotsam and points of interest that you can explore. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39178976/b3e060aae220ef8a31e199061c7be99add628802.png[/img]


[h2]Island expeditions rework[/h2]
For a long time we weren't feeling very happy with how the island expedition system functioned. The islands felt disconnected from the actual terrain in the world, you couldn't explore every location on the island, and individual sailors weren't playing an active role during encounters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39178976/0b5da9027f2a9f6a6624f3ace0c2ccbed73e9352.png[/img]

In 0.7 we have addressed all of these issues: now you have a map which follows actual terrain; expedition crew is smaller, sailors directly carry items and pass attribute checks and you can revisit any island and explore locations in any order you want.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39178976/e83cfb8c8f3ed11c3df8095e99d06ee9f629ecb4.png[/img]
[i][Preview] UI is still in progress[/i]

We are also revising all existing encounters, improving their gameplay as well as adding new ones.

[h2]Crew equipment[/h2]
We've reworked crew assignments, reducing the overall number of sailors by roughly 40-50%, which will make it easier to keep track of them. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39178976/1ea2ca5fdc7783a5e55936494249049539e3e2a3.png[/img]

The circular tokens represent a new feature - assignable items. As you explore islands and points of interests, loot enemy ships and complete quests you will gain rare items that you can directly assign to the sailor, boosting his stats and job performance.

Patch 0.7 will have a clearer interaction between sailor attributes and effects that they provide on a ship, i.e. rigger's fitness impacting ship's speed, steward's craftsmanship impacting repair speed etc.
Some of the crew and sailor attributes are undergoing changes too. For example sailors are now having individual health, allowing them to be injured and healed instead of dying instantly.

We will be showing more of all new crew improvements in the next dev diary.

[h2]Release date[/h2]
Patch 0.7 is coming live on Steam on December 23rd. As always, your support brings us a lot of energy boosting the development, so please leave a like, comment and If you have any questions - we are always active in our Steam community and Discord.

That's it for today!

notes.title: Development Roadmap
notes.content:
Greetings seafarers, today we are going to share our plans for the future!

First things first, thank you all for taking part in our Early Access. We have gained lots of helpful feedback and bug reports during 0.6 and we hope that you will continue this journey towards 1.0 together with us.

[h2]Patch 0.7[/h2]
As we have been developing Maritime Calling over the last couple years, we have breezed through a lot of prototypes (some of which are still present and overcomplicate our systems). Our first order of business is perform maintenance over the core of our game:
[list]
[*] resolve terrain bottleneck with planting large forests, leading to tighter packed maps (with ships, islands and point of interest) and more FPS when you sail close to islands
[*] much better looking islands and more landscape diversity
[*] adding more types of lootable objects to the world
[*] upgrade our game engine, leading to more FPS in game and better graphics (especially adding MSAA)
[*] code cleanup, to improve stability of our systems and streamline development of the new ones
[*] improve ship textures (exterior and interior)
[*] decrease performance load from ships and spikes when enemy is spawned
[*] simplify crew assignments (no longer requiring you to have 1 sailor on each sail and reworking gun crews)
[*] add animations to all sailor tasks
[*] add new sailor model
[/list]
This patch will be mainly focused on improving game performance and visuals.

[h2]After 0.7[/h2]
After that we will be improving our game features, here are some goals that we have set:
[list]
[*] add social aspects to the crew: responding to captain decisions, interactions between sailors, more personalities and improve leveling system
[*] island expedition that follow actual shape of the island with allowing player to freely move between locations and explore all locations on the island
[*] combat improvements: boarding, capitulation, parley and allow you to target specific parts of enemy ship when firing
[*] adding ship options to select from at the start of the game, allow you to buy ship at ports and to replace it with opponent's ship when you board her
[/list]

This is just a list of more pressing issues, we have many other cool concepts in the making that are not ready to share yet.

[h2]Release when?[/h2]
Our plans are to release the patch 1.0 in March 2022. We ask you to complete this journey together with us and we promise to provide high quality updates along the way. 

That's it for today!

notes.title: Maritime Calling Beta is here!
notes.content:
We are delighted to announce that our development cycle is approaching release (on September, 28th) with open beta lasting until the end of the week (August, 29th). You can play beta by hitting "Playtest" on our steam page.

Over the last couple months we worked hard to bring new exciting features to you!

[h2]New feature: naval combat[/h2]
You can now fight real-time naval battles! Enemy ships are fully simulated and operate the same way you do. You will be required to maneuver your ship, fire cannons, watch out for your positioning to get the strongest shots, give captain orders boosting your stats and shoot at specific targets: just sinking enemy ship by destroying it's hull or destroying their guns so they can't fight back or demoralizing them and making sure they surrender.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39178976/889f0d8653ea0afd91afba19dfbb4f993acb5630.png[/img]

[h2]New feature: revamped island expeditions[/h2]
We gathered feedback regarding 'kickstarter-campaign-version-islands' and come up with a better design for expeditions. The islands are now shorter and form a path to the 'center' of the island. Every location contains unknown encounter, that is driven by its terrain (like you can find boars on glades or river in the forest). Text encounters are now shorter and more mechanical (with attribute checks and items usage) and crew is back to being the cornerstone of your expedition success.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39178976/095268d698cf04a3b1ec13c9b6a2d206e5cb8236.png[/img]

[h2]New workplaces: blacksmith and carpenter[/h2]
Blacksmith and carpenter play a key role is survival aspect of Maritime Calling. They provide a way of crafting ammunition for naval combat and items for expeditions: axes, cuirasses and muskets.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39178976/5c3d3437415868471985380b1349d853b9426cde.png[/img]

That's all for today! We are currently striving for feedback, so if you try out Maritime Calling Beta, please leave your reviews on our community hub.
